monitoring.honestCeiling: This is EMISSION plus RETRIEVAL BY QUERY. It is not aggregation and it is not alerting: nothing pages anyone. Every operational event in the catalogue is a FAILURE event or an Expert event, so a clean release legitimately emits none, and zero events is the correct outcome rather than evidence of missing instrumentation. syntheticCleanup.whyRetained: Report immutability is a product guarantee (RR-2): every issued revision is retained, byte-identical and downloadable. Deleting the synthetic report to tidy up would have required violating the exact guarantee this section was verifying, and deleting the storage object alone would have left a storage_objects row pointing at bytes that no longer exist — a worse state than a clearly labelled synthetic record in a system with no users. The residue is named here so the product owner can remove it deliberately.
